items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I had no idea that there was anybody around that could play like that until I heard Sonny.

ctx.x: How do you mean something else? And don't say next question! (Laughs)

That’s a good question! (Laughs) it is just that he was unusual. That is a better word. Sonny was the, unusual, extremely accurate, and he had all his energy and stamina. You know, it was just amazing. It was amazing to me that anybody could come along after Charlie Parker had been on the scene, and play like that and make you say, "Oh, really?" That was the first time… I had no idea that there was anybody around that could play like that until I heard Sonny. He was fantastic.
And Cannonball affected you in the same way?
